metaTitle: Custom Zippered Drawstring Backpacks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom zippered drawstring backpacks for your team. Secure storage and full-color imprint. Fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Standard drawstring backpacks are great for light carry, but when you need security for phones, wallets, or keys, a zippered main compartment makes all the difference. Custom with zipper drawstring backpacks combine the lightweight convenience of a cinch sack with the peace of mind of a zip closure. The Recycled PET Two-Tone Drawstring Backpack is a popular choice for eco-conscious companies outfitting event staff or field crews. Choose screen printing or embroidery for your logo across the front panel, and keep gear safe without adding bulk.
heroAltText: Custom zippered drawstring backpacks with secure zipper closure and full-color logo imprint for corporate events
